{{Short description|Cipher Device}}The '''Japanese M-1 cipher machine''' was a mechanical device the Japanese used for performing cryptography sometime during the 1930s.  More specifically it was used by naval attaches.  The US called it the ''ORANGE machine''.

Cryptographically it is similar to the [[Red (cipher machine)|Red cipher]]; it was broken by [[Agnes Meyer Driscoll|Agnes Driscoll]] (Madame X).<ref>{{Cite book|page=[https://archive.org/details/militarycommunic00ster_813/page/n167 127]|title=Military Communications: From Ancient Times to the 21st Century|url=https://archive.org/details/militarycommunic00ster_813|url-access=limited|others=Editor:Christopher H. Sterling|publisher=ABC-CLIO|date=2008|isbn=9781851097326}}</ref>
